purpose: Restore twelve runnable short arms after two temperature and two expert-count refills.
hypothesis: A learned linear router may use feature magnitude that cosine routing discards, making assignments more causally important at the conflict-localized FFNs.
alternative_explanation: Any change is fixed partitioning or top-2 active compute rather than learned routing.
falsifier: Frozen matches learned within top-k, route reliance remains below 0.01, or mean/tail metrics are dominated.
